scripts.install:all: npm i && npm --prefix apps/api i && npm --prefix apps/web i
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:reset:wsl: wsl docker compose down -v && wsl docker compose up -d
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "cd apps/ai && .venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
